# Cash rent or crop share: which lease pays more, and for whom?

> Free farmland lease calculator: compare cash rent, crop share and flexible cash leases for the landlord and the operator at your own yield, price and costs, with the break-even yield and who carries the risk. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
